field_checks.summary: Primary Table 2 has 26 numeric inhibition-zone observations and 10 dash exclusions, but current final records mis-parse the first data row: Group 1 S. aureus and L. monocytogenes values are omitted/shifted, and raw_value "1" is emitted from the group label.

Five DBAASP/Codex fallback candidate rows are retained as unresolved_record with no authoritative linked DBAASP/APD6/DRAMP rows and no exact sequence evidence. This is not portal/RC2 ingest-ready, but fallback rows are not promoted as source_verified.

Common paper/packet final layer files are byte-identical and review counts match 29 activity, 4 toxicity, 5 database audits, 3 mechanism claims, and 0 rework targets. File sets are asymmetric: paper final has materials_manifest.json while packet final has mechanism_evidence.json alias.

Mechanism ontology no longer promotes discussion/permeability wording to direct_mechanism. Current claims are inferred_mechanism, phenotype_supported, and inferred_mechanism, all with empty direct_assay_types.

Paper identity is clear: PMCID PMC11897483, PMID 40078294, DOI 10.3389/fphar.2025.1530043, bacteriocin P7 from B. velezensis G7. Exact P7 sequence is not source-reviewable from linked database rows, so identity remains paper-level, not authoritative database-sequence linkage.

All cited XML/PDF locators resolve, but worker-2 source_cell provenance is wrong for Table 2 first data row: the final maps cell text from a group label into an activity value. The activity artifact also contradicts database manifests by marking authoritative_linked_rows_present=true despite zero linked authoritative rows.

Recursive authority and fallback release boundaries are mostly preserved: strict audit and database final keep authoritative_dbaasp_ingest_ready=false and fallback rows candidate-only. The worker-2 activity metadata inconsistency noted above must be corrected before publication-grade readiness.

Existing database-unlinked and hemolysis-threshold cautions are preserved, but the current accepted state fails to preserve newly verified source conflicts in activity/toxicity: Table 2 first-row values are shifted and Figure 10A exact hemolysis labels are replaced by threshold-only rows.

The source and packet supplementary directories are readable and empty; supplementary_index reports zero files, supplementary_text is empty, supplementary_tables has no tables, archive_manifest has no archives, and the XML metadata indicates no PMC supplement.

Toxicity coverage is not exact enough for publication grade. Figure 10A visibly reports MIC=0.8193%, 2MIC=3.7988%, and 4MIC=10.949% hemolysis; final records keep only <10% for MIC and 2MIC plus 10.949% for 4MIC, omitting exact source values.

blocking_findings.reason: Worker-2 final activity/toxicity evidence is not source-faithful. Table 2 is row/column-shifted: primary XML/PDF show Group 1 S. aureus = 13.97 ± 0.12 mm and Group 1 L. monocytogenes = 16.11 ± 0.2 mm, but final records emit raw_value "1" for S. aureus and shift 13.97 ± 0.12 to L. monocytogenes under source_table_row_label "Inhibition circle diameter (mm)". Figure 10A also provides exact hemolysis labels 0.8193%, 3.7988%, and 10.949%, but final toxicity records replace the first two with threshold-only <10% rows. Current strict acceptance reports zero hard findings, so this must be reopened rather than accepted around.

Remove the placeholder-like raw_value "1" record and the shifted Listeria record; keep the 10 dash cells as explicit exclusions with correct Group 1 E. coli and P. aeruginosa coordinates.
Re-extract Figure 10A toxicity as exact visual/PDF evidence: MIC 0.8193%, 2MIC 3.7988%, and 4MIC 10.949%, while retaining p49/p57 threshold prose only as separate approximate/caution evidence.
Correct worker-2 provenance metadata so authoritative_linked_rows_present agrees with database_source_manifest and authoritative_match_report zero linked authoritative rows.
Rebuild worker-2 work artifact, packet analysis artifact, paper final, and packet final, then send back for fresh worker-6 adjudication and strict gate rerun without allow flags.

A final-record scan finds zero Table 2 activity records with raw_value "1" and zero records whose source_table_row_label is "Inhibition circle diameter (mm)" as a fermentation group.

A Figure 10A toxicity check finds exact percent hemolysis records for MIC=0.8193, 2MIC=3.7988, and 4MIC=10.949 with source_locator including pdf:page=12 or xml:fig:10; threshold-only rows are marked approximate/caution, not exact substitutes.
